purpose: FROZEN mark-price source for the near-real MTM valuation lane (observation/accounting only; no strategy identity change)

chosen_source.name: binance_fapi_premium_index_bulk
chosen_source.method: GET (no symbol parameter => ONE bulk response covering ALL symbols)

fields_used.markPrice: the venue mark price — the exact price class at which funding settles (contract-aligned for a funding-carry observation)
fields_used.time: per-symbol server timestamp (ms since epoch UTC); recorded per mark as source_timestamp_utc (max over used symbols, ISO-8601 Z)

chosen_source.batch_plan: ONE bulk call per 300s valuation loop for ALL families and ALL open-position symbols; per-symbol prices are extracted from the single response array; a symbol absent from the response is a MISSING price => that sleeve's mark is UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED (never stale reuse, never interpolation)
chosen_source.keyless_statement: keyless public read; NO API keys are read, stored or required; no accounts, no orders; emitted action stays TARGET_INTENT

rationale: premiumIndex markPrice is the venue's own mark-of-record for funding settlement — the economically correct mark for MTM valuation of perpetual positions of a funding-carry family

the no-symbol variant returns EVERY symbol in ONE response (measured 199740 bytes, ~0.5s), so the ACTIVE_LIGHT worker makes exactly ONE network read per loop regardless of how many sleeves/symbols are open
markPrice is a point-in-time mark carrying its own server timestamp; it has NO bar-completeness ambiguity (see the rejected klines candidate below)

the klines candidate was MEASURED to return the currently-open (uncompleted) 1m bar at limit=1 (row open_time 1789434120000, close_time 1789434179999, fetched at 1789434144543 < close_time): marking on its close would violate the frozen completeness rule, and the completed-bar workaround needs one call PER SYMBOL per loop, breaking the single-read batch plan
explicit_no_uncompleted_bar_rule: valuation NEVER marks on an uncompleted bar. The frozen source is premiumIndex markPrice (not a bar). Any future bar-derived mark must use bars whose canonical close time is strictly in the past at fetch time; an uncompleted bar is UNAVAILABLE, never 'close so far'.

klines_BTCUSDT_1m_limit1_REJECTED.verdict: REJECTED — limit=1 returns the IN-PROGRESS bar; its close is not a completed mark

unavailable_fail_closed: if the network read fails or any open-position symbol is missing from the bulk response, the mark for that sleeve is recorded with accounting_status UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED and equity=null; the previous mark is never reused and no price is ever interpolated
